## How to use this plan
Draw for ten minutes a day. Time every attempt. Review each attempt the next morning and write one thing to change.

## Your week
| Day | Focus | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Monday | Lines and shapes | 30 minutes |
| Wednesday | Shading and texture | 30 minutes |
| Friday | A full timed scene | 45 minutes |
| Saturday | Review the week | 30 minutes |

## Checklist
- Draw every day
- Time every attempt
- Keep every sheet to compare week by week
